zh: 移动端（iOS & Android）更新至 v1.1.0 (4)：实时语音通话升级为流式分句并行合成与无缝排队播报，端到端尾音检测收紧至约 715ms，首字播报延迟大幅降低。
锁定跨轮次一致的 AI 声线与语调，支持 5 种预设音色随心切换（默认沉稳 Kore），并新增进退语音模式的高品质双音微提示与触感反馈。
修复安卓应用名称与启动图标配置为 Dragon Claw，并新增后台服务日志导出及桌面首页侧栏拖拽优化。
en: Bump iOS & Android apps to v1.1.0 (4): upgrade live voice conversations with streaming clause pipelining, concurrent ordered TTS synthesis, gapless playback, and 715ms VAD turn-taking.
Lock consistent cross-turn voice tone and speaking persona (default Kore) with a 5-voice persona selector and distinct studio chimes for starting and ending voice calls.
Update the Android app name and adaptive launcher icons to Dragon Claw, alongside service log export and home conversation rail drag polish.
